# SourceTrait
> Portable. Extendable. Freedom.

SourceTrait is an open-source software studio with a focus on productivity
and development kits.

## Projects

### SourceTrait Common
Our common Rust library that we use internally.

#### Links
- [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcetrait/sourcetrait_common)

## Projects (Early Development)

### SourceTrait Grammar
Our LLM toolkit.

Provides common governance between Claude and ChatGPT for use on Podman
containers based on Fedora Toolbx.

Ships the Grammar MCP which uses the latest Nushell as the primary scripting
and shell language.

#### Links
- [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcetrait/grammar)

### SourceTrait Jab
RISC-V assembly kernel and SDK.

Intended to be ran with a gamepad via either QEMU emulation on
Linux / MacOS / Windows or on native RVA23 compliant hardware.

Intentionally standardizes low-resource system specifications to reach a
broader audience via emulation and to simplfy game development.

Targeted towards LLM-assisted development and distribution of open-source
games written entirely in RISC-V assembly.

#### Links
- [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcetrait/jab)
- [Website](https://jab.computer) (Currently redirects to GitHub)
